obligations.ask: Return confirmation that the parking charge details are correct

results.segment: Confirmation that the parking charge details are correct must be returned within 42 days of the date of this letter.
The parking charge is being checked by the department that holds it, and any correction is applied automatically within 30 days.
This part of the letter is sent for information only.
Your appointment on 12 May was attended and the notes have been added to your record.
